sources.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal production animation atlas. Reference is the current in-game identity; preserve the species, silhouette, colors, clothing and equipment, while redrawing clean polished anime chibi cel-shaded game sprites. Transparent RGBA. Exactly SIXTEEN complete sprites in a precise FOUR columns by FOUR rows square sheet, equal invisible cells. Rows top to bottom: IDLE four visibly distinct breathing/looking poses; WALK four alternating locomotion key poses; ATTACK ready, windup, strong contact, recovery; CAST prepare, gather, release with equipment, return. Three-quarter facing RIGHT in every cell. Uniform scale across ALL poses; feet/base on same baseline. Center each complete actor inside the central 65% of its cell with at least 15% transparent gutter on all sides. Keep all hands, beaks, tails, spouts, cloud ornaments, stone limbs and weapons fully inside their own cell. No overlaps between cells; no copied neighbor fragments. No painted VFX, particles, trails, ground, shadow, background, text, labels, numbers, cell outlines, watermark. Actual production animation art; not a concept poster. Identity invariants: A wide sentient CELADON JADE TEAPOT creature, round jade ceramic belly with cream spiral patterns, ornate BRONZE low foot ring and lid finial, a long curved spout on its left and curved handle on its right, rounded ivory CLOUD billows clustered on top of its lid. No humanoid face or limbs added. Moves by tilting and small base hops; attack leans the spout, cast raises lid and turns spout. Preserve the squat broad teapot silhouette and bronze hardware.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal second production animation sheet. The first reference is the newly approved combat sheet: MATCH that exact creature design, colors, body proportions and line/shading style. Keep uniform character scale equivalent to the first sheet. Transparent RGBA. Exactly SIXTEEN complete actors in a precise FOUR column by FOUR row square sheet, equal invisible cells, each entire actor centered in central 65% with 15% empty gutters on every edge. Rows from top: row1 PHASE CHANGE / SPECIAL CAST: brace, gather by distinct physical gesture, powerful release pose, recover; row2 HIT: startled, recoil left, recoil back, recover; row3 DEFEAT: stagger, lower/kneel or tilt, lie collapsed on floor, final fully collapsed horizontal repose (alive game monster, no injury); row4 VICTORY: stand proudly, lift arms/wing/spout, flourish, settle. Four physically distinct poses per row. Three-quarter RIGHT, identical equipment/anatomy throughout. Hold long equipment compactly; full actor incl tail/beak/hat/handle/lid/weapon stays inside cell. No painted magic or particles except integral material such as the teapot's attached cloud decoration. No ground, cast shadow, scenery, text, labels, grid, watermark; no other characters. The squat jade teapot NEVER gains human arms, legs, eyes or a mouth; it rocks/hops on bronze foot ring. Phase raises lid, hit rocks back, defeat rolls gently on its side with lid lowered, victory lifts spout. Preserve gold hardware, jade glaze and ivory attached cloud shapes.
